AD2E.Character.Name: Name
AD2E.Roll.ModifierNoteHint: e.g. ring of protection, cover, blessed
AD2E.Test.NotAvailable: {test} is not available at this ability score.

AD2E.Class.OtherRequirements: This kit also has race, alignment or other restrictions; see the linked page.
AD2E.Class.DropKit: Drag a Class Kit item here
AD2E.Class.DragHint: Drag a Race, a Class and then a Class Kit from the Items directory or the "Races (PHB)", "Classes (PHB)" and "Class Kits" compendiums onto this sheet. Dropping a new one replaces the current one.
AD2E.Class.NeedClassFirst: Add a Class before adding a Class Kit.
AD2E.Class.KitDoesNotFit: This kit is not available to the current class.

AD2E.Item.kitClassesHint: Comma-separated class identifiers, e.g. fighter, paladin
AD2E.Item.otherRequirements: Has race, alignment or other restrictions
AD2E.Item.kitMinHint: Overrides the class minimum for that ability. Blank keeps the class minimum; 0 removes it.

AD2E.Save.OverrideHint: Override (blank uses PHB Table 60 for the class group and level)
AD2E.Save.RollBonus: Bonus added to the roll: racial Constitution bonus (PHB Table 9, vs. rod/staff/wand and spell) and paladin +2 (all saves)

AD2E.HP.Fixed: +{hp} HP (fixed; no hit die or CON bonus at this level)
AD2E.HP.ConfirmReset: This character is above 1st level. Replace current and maximum HP with a new 1st-level roll?
AD2E.HP.XpRestart: hierophant druid: counted from 1 XP after stepping down as Grand Druid at 16th level

AD2E.Race.InfravisionByLineage: Infravision depends on lineage (see source page)
AD2E.Race.ConSaves: CON bonus vs. rod/staff/wand and spells (Table 9)
AD2E.Race.SaveBonus: Racial CON bonus (Table 9), added to the roll
AD2E.Race.PoisonBonus: Racial CON bonus vs. poison only (Table 9)
AD2E.Race.RolledScore: Rolled score (checked against the race's Table 7 limits)
AD2E.Race.EffectiveScore: Effective score: rolled + racial adjustment (Table 8); used for all tables and rolls
AD2E.Race.ClassNotAllowed: This race cannot take the current class.
AD2E.Race.LevelLimitReached: This race cannot advance beyond level {limit} in this class. Edit the level directly if your DM allows it.
AD2E.Race.KitRaceLimitsHint: race level, comma-separated, e.g. dwarf 15, gnome 6 (no number = unlimited)
AD2E.Race.NeedsRaceKit: {race} can only be a {class} through a kit that allows {race}; add one.
AD2E.Race.NeedsKitNote: This race can only take this class through a kit that allows the race; add a qualifying kit.
AD2E.Race.KitNotForRace: {kit} is not available to {race} for this class.

AD2E.Prof.CrossGroup: Outside this class's proficiency groups (Table 38): +1 slot
AD2E.Prof.CheckHint: Proficiency check: 1d20 ≤ this number (a 20 always fails)
AD2E.Prof.DragHint: Drag proficiencies from the "Proficiencies" compendium onto this sheet. Adding a Class Kit adds its bonus proficiencies (free) and required proficiencies (use slots); removing the kit removes its bonus proficiencies.
AD2E.Prof.ChooseOne: Choose one proficiency granted by this kit.

AD2E.Weapon.NoDamage: {name} has no damage listed on the PHB weapon list.
AD2E.Weapon.Specialize: Weapon specialization (fighters only): one extra slot, two for bows
AD2E.Weapon.SpecInvalid: Specialization requires a single-class fighter and a single specialized weapon
AD2E.Weapon.NoWeaponData: No weapon data; remove and re-add this proficiency from the compendium
AD2E.Weapon.PointBlankHint: Point blank range available (+2 to hit)
AD2E.Weapon.DropNotProficient: {name}: no matching weapon proficiency; attacks take the non-proficiency penalty ({penalty}).
AD2E.Weapon.DragHint: Weight of weapons, ammunition and armour counts toward encumbrance. Drag armour from the "Armour (PHB)" compendium and weapons and ammunition from the "Weapons (PHB)" compendium onto this sheet. A weapon uses the weapon proficiency with the same identifier; specialization is set on the proficiency. Firing a launcher uses one piece of the chosen ammunition; throwing a weapon uses one from its quantity.
AD2E.Weapon.EquipHint: No weapon is equipped: all weapons are shown. Tick Equipped on a weapon to list only the weapons in hand.

AD2E.Ammo.LaunchersHint: Fired from: comma-separated weapon identifiers (e.g. long-bow, short-bow).
AD2E.Ammo.None: {name}: no ammunition left. Add ammunition that fits it, or raise its quantity.

AD2E.Armor.RearHint: Attacks from behind: no shield, no beneficial Dexterity adjustment
AD2E.Armor.Unused: Another equipped item of this kind gives a better AC; this one is not counted
AD2E.Armor.MiscHint: Magical items (rings, cloaks or bracers of protection), spells, cover: positive improves (lowers) Armour Class. Applies to all AC values.

AD2E.Enc.MagicArmorHint: Magical armour counts toward the most weight that can be carried, not toward movement or combat (Encumbrance (PHB))
AD2E.Enc.OverMax: Over the most weight that can be carried: cannot move
AD2E.Enc.SettingHint: PHB optional rules: basic categories (Table 47), specific movement (Table 48), or off.

AD2E.Move.Hint: Movement rate: tens of feet per round in dungeons, tens of yards per round outdoors (Movement (PHB))
AD2E.Move.SneakHint: Cautious (dungeon) pace: movement rate in tens of feet per round (Movement (PHB)). Thief Move Silently is a separate skill.
AD2E.Move.WalkHint: Walking pace: movement rate in tens of yards per round; at this pace in a dungeon, -1 to surprise rolls, +1 to others' chance of being surprised, and traps are not noticed (Movement (PHB))
AD2E.Move.CombatHint: Combat round: movement x 10 ft. Close to melee and attack: {close} ft; withdraw: {withdraw} ft; charge: {charge} ft (+2 to hit, AC +1, no Dexterity bonus) (Movement in Combat (PHB))
AD2E.Move.JogHint: Double movement in yards; {rounds} rounds (Constitution), then a Constitution check each round (Movement (PHB))
AD2E.Move.RunHint: x3 with a Strength check, x4 with a Strength check at -4; Constitution check each round at -1 (x3) / -2 (x4) per round run, cumulative (Movement (PHB))
AD2E.Move.SprintHint: x5 with a Strength check at -8; Constitution check each round at -3 per round, cumulative (Movement (PHB))
AD2E.Move.JumpHint: Jumping proficiency (PHB): running broad / running high · standing broad / standing high (ft); 20 ft running start; click to roll
AD2E.Move.NoJump: The PHB gives jump distances only for the Jumping proficiency
AD2E.Move.BroadCap: no more than six times the character's height
AD2E.Move.HighCap: no more than 1 1/2 times the character's height
AD2E.Move.MarchHint: Miles per 10-hour day: march (x2) / force march (x2 1/2, Constitution check each day) (Movement (PHB))

AD2E.Coin.Hint: Exchange (PHB Table 42): 1 pp = 5 gp, 1 gp = 2 ep = 10 sp = 100 cp. Coins of any metal weigh 50 to the pound (DMG) and count toward encumbrance.
AD2E.Coin.NoneYet: No coins yet. Drag coins from the "Equipment (PHB)" compendium; a dropped stack joins an owned stack of the same coin.

AD2E.Gear.CarriedHint: Carried items count toward encumbrance (weight x quantity)
AD2E.Gear.LoadFull: Animal load at full move (lb, PHB Table 49)
AD2E.Gear.NoneYet: No gear yet. Drag items from the "Equipment (PHB)" compendium.

AD2E.Monster.HitDiceHint: As written in the Monstrous Manual: 3, 3+3, 1-1, 1/2, 2-8 hp. Hit Dice are d8.
AD2E.Monster.MoraleHint: Morale check: 2d10, the creature stands on a total at or below its morale (Morale (DMG))
AD2E.Monster.SaveLevelHint: Save level = Hit Dice (+1 per 4 added points or fraction); non-intelligent creatures use half except vs. paralyzation, poison and death magic (The Saving Throw (DMG))
AD2E.Monster.InventoryHint: Drag weapons, armour, equipment and coins here. Equipped armour sets AC; weapons add attacks; carried weight counts toward a mount's load.
AD2E.Monster.NoAttacks: No attacks: add one, or drag a weapon onto the sheet.

AD2E.Importer.Title: Monster importer (Complete Compendium)
AD2E.Importer.MenuHint: Import monster stat blocks from completecompendium.com into this world as Monster / NPC actors, by setting and source book.
AD2E.Importer.Hint: Imports stat blocks (game statistics), a link to each monster's page and its picture (shown from the site, not copied) as portrait and token; the descriptions stay on the site. Source:
AD2E.Importer.Folder: Put new actors in a folder named after the book
AD2E.Importer.SomeFailed: {n} monster page(s) could not be loaded: {keys}

AD2E.Spell.NoCaster: This class casts no spells (or no class item yet).
AD2E.Spell.RestHint: After rest: every memorized spell can be cast again
AD2E.Spell.DragHint: Drag spells from the "Spells (examples)" compendium or from imported spells (Configure Settings > Import spells). Set how many times each is memorized with -/+; Cast uses one.
AD2E.Spell.KnownHint: Wizards: most spells per level in the spell book (Intelligence, PHB Table 4)
AD2E.Spell.NotForClass: not a spell of this class
AD2E.Spell.Remaining: {n} left to cast until the next rest.
AD2E.Spell.WrongKind: {name} is not a spell the {class} class can cast; it is added but not counted.
AD2E.Spell.OppositionSchool: {name} belongs to an opposition school of the {class}.
AD2E.Spell.SphereNotAllowed: {name} is outside the spheres the {class} can cast.

AD2E.SpellImporter.Title: Spell importer (AD&D 2e wiki)
AD2E.SpellImporter.MenuHint: Import spells from the AD&D 2e wiki into this world as spell items, by source book, class and level.
AD2E.SpellImporter.Hint: Imports game statistics (school, sphere, level, range, components, casting time, duration, area, save) and a link to each spell's page; the descriptions stay on the wiki. Source:
AD2E.SpellImporter.Folder: File spells into folders by class and spell level (e.g. Wizard Spells / Level 3)
AD2E.SpellImporter.Skipped: {n} page(s) without a usable spell infobox were skipped.

AD2E.Skill.BudgetHint: Thief: 60 at 1st level, +30 per level, no more than 30 on one skill at 1st level and 15 per level after. Bard: 20 at 1st level, +15 per level (PHB).
AD2E.Skill.Cap: No thief skill above 95% including all adjustments (Thief (PHB))
AD2E.Skill.RangerNote: Studded leather or lighter armour only; halved outside natural surroundings (Ranger (PHB)).
AD2E.Skill.TrapNote: Removing a trap: a roll of 96-100 sets it off (Thief Skill Explanations (PHB)).
AD2E.Skill.KitAdjustHint: Percentage added to (or taken from) the character's thief, bard or ranger skills while the kit fits the class. Kit pages give these in their text; enter them here.
AD2E.Skill.PerSkillMax: At most {n} points on one skill at this level

AD2E.Ability2.BackstabText: +4 to hit from behind an unaware, roughly humanoid victim; damage ×{mult} (Table 30), first attack only.
AD2E.Ability2.TurnHint: Roll 1d20: equal to or above the number turns; T = turned, D = destroyed, D* = 2d4 more destroyed; a success affects 2d6 undead (Turning Undead (PHB)).
AD2E.Ability2.LayOnHandsText: Heals {hp} hit points (2 per level), once per day.
AD2E.Ability2.LayOnHandsUsed: Lay on hands has been used today; rest to restore it.
AD2E.Ability2.LayOnHandsChat: Lay on hands: {hp} hit points restored.
AD2E.Ability2.KitText: Special benefits and hindrances are described on the kit page:
AD2E.Ability2.Rested: {name} rested: memorized spells and daily abilities restored.
AD2E.Ability2.None: This class has no special abilities listed here (or no class item yet).

specialization.name: Weapon specialization
specialization.text: Extra weapon slots buy specialization: see the Proficiencies tab.

followers.name: Followers
followers.text: At 9th level attracts men-at-arms and an elite bodyguard (Table 16).

detectEvil.name: Detect evil
detectEvil.text: Senses evil intent up to 60 feet in one direction; takes a round; at will.

saves.name: +2 to all saving throws
saves.text: Added to every saving throw roll (included in the Saves table).

disease.name: Immune to disease
disease.text: Curses such as lycanthropy and mummy rot are not diseases.

layOnHands.name: Lay on hands
layOnHands.text: Heals 2 hit points per level, once per day.

cureDisease.name: Cure disease
cureDisease.text: Once per week for every five levels (levels 1-5: once, 6-10: twice, ...).

aura.name: Aura of protection
aura.text: 10-foot radius: summoned and evil creatures have -1 to attack rolls.

turnUndead.name: Turn undead
turnUndead.text: From 3rd level, as a cleric two levels lower.

spells.name: Priest spells
spells.text: From 9th level: combat, divination, healing and protection spheres (Table 17); no Wisdom bonus.

noFollowers.name: No followers
noFollowers.text: Attracts no followers; may hire lawful good soldiers and specialists.

twoWeapons.name: Two weapons
twoWeapons.text: No penalty fighting with two weapons in studded leather or lighter armour (no shield).

tracking.name: Tracking
tracking.text: Tracking proficiency for free; +1 per three levels (3rd-5th +1, 6th-8th +2, ...).

stealth.name: Hide in shadows / move silently
stealth.text: Table 18 by level, race and Dexterity adjusted; studded leather or lighter; halved outside natural surroundings.

speciesEnemy.name: Species enemy
speciesEnemy.text: Chosen before 2nd level: +4 to attack rolls against it.

animals.name: Animal empathy
animals.text: Befriends domestic animals; wild or attack-trained animals save vs. rods at -1 per three ranger levels.

spells.name: Priest spells
spells.text: From 8th level: plant and animal spheres (Table 18); no Wisdom bonus.

turnUndead.name: Turn undead
turnUndead.text: Table 61 at the cleric's level (evil clerics command instead).

followers.name: Followers
followers.text: At 8th level, with a place of worship of significant size, attracts believers.

stronghold.name: Stronghold
stronghold.text: At 9th level may receive approval to establish a religious stronghold.

language.name: Druidic language
language.text: Secret language of druids (no proficiency slot).

passPlants.name: Pass through overgrowth
passPlants.text: From 3rd level, at normal movement and leaving no trail.

woodlandLanguages.name: Woodland languages
woodlandLanguages.text: One language of woodland creatures at 3rd level and one more each level after.

charmImmunity.name: Immune to woodland charm
charmImmunity.text: From 7th level, immune to charm spells of woodland creatures.

shapechange.name: Shapechange
shapechange.text: From 7th level, up to three times a day (reptile, bird, mammal; each once a day).

skills.name: Thief skills
skills.text: Tables 26-29 plus discretionary points: see the skills table.

backstab.name: Backstab
backstab.text: +4 to hit, damage multiplied by Table 30; first attack only.

scrolls.name: Use scrolls
scrolls.text: From 10th level; 25% chance to read the scroll wrongly (reversed effect).

abilities.name: Bard abilities
abilities.text: Climb walls, detect noise, pick pockets, read languages (Table 33) plus points: see the table.

influence.name: Influence reactions
influence.text: A performance can shift the mood of a group that is not attacking.

counterSong.name: Counter song
counterSong.text: Allies within 30 feet are immune to song or poetry attacks while the bard counters (save vs. spell).

spells.name: Wizard spells
spells.text: From 2nd level (Table 32); kept in a spell book.

scrolls.name: Use magical writings
scrolls.text: From 10th level; 15% chance of reading an item wrongly.

spellBook.name: Spell book
spellBook.text: Spells are memorized from the spell book; a spell cast is gone until memorized again.

learnSpells.name: Learning spells
learnSpells.text: A new spell is learned on a percentile roll at or under the Intelligence chance to learn (Table 4), up to the maximum spells per level.

noArmor.name: No armour
noArmor.text: Wizards wear no armour; weapons: dagger, staff, darts, knives and slings.

magicItems.name: Magical items
magicItems.text: Can use more magical items than any other class: potions, rings, wands, rods, scrolls and most miscellaneous items.

scrollsPotions.name: Scrolls and potions
scrollsPotions.text: From 9th level, can write magical scrolls and brew potions; other items need the right spells.

noStronghold.name: Henchmen and apprentices
noStronghold.text: No special benefit from a stronghold; may acquire a few henchmen and apprentices.

extraSpell.name: Extra school spell
extraSpell.text: One additional spell per spell level, of the specialist's school (included in the Spells tab).

schoolSaves.name: School saving throws
schoolSaves.text: +1 to saves against spells of the school cast by other wizards; others save at -1 against the specialist's school spells.

learnBonus.name: Learning spells
learnBonus.text: +15% to learn spells of the school, -15% for other schools.

opposition.name: Opposition schools
opposition.text: Cannot learn spells of the opposition schools or use items that duplicate them (see the Race & Class tab).

newSpellLevel.name: Free school spell
newSpellLevel.text: Gains one spell of the school for the spell book on reaching each new spell level.

Armor.light: in no armour, leather or padded

AD2E.Kit.ModifiersHint: Taken from the kit page (curated; the kit link has the full rules). Applied modifiers are already in the sheet's numbers; situational ones can be ticked in the roll dialog; reaction and surprise modifiers are for the DM's rolls. Armour Class bonuses mean a better (lower) AC; an initiative bonus lowers the initiative roll.
AD2E.Kit.SheetHint: Generated from the kit page by tools/build-kit-mechanics.py; modifiers without a condition apply automatically while the kit fits the character's class.
AD2E.Kit.NoModifiers: No numeric modifiers are stated on the kit page.
AD2E.Kit.SkillPoints: Thief skill points: {first} at 1st level, {per} per level after

AD2E.Magic.SheetHint: Magical armour and weapons are armour and weapon items with a magical bonus. Charges: each use spends one (wands are found with 1d20+80). Potions, scrolls and dusts are used up from the quantity. Effects on rolls: add them in the roll dialog's modifier; on Armour Class: the character's Other AC adjustment.
AD2E.Magic.UseHint: Spend a charge (or one potion, scroll or dust) and post the item to chat
AD2E.Magic.NoneYet: No magical items. Drag magical items here.

AD2E.Treasure.SheetHint: Gems with no value entered are worth their DMG Table 85 class base value (uncut: 10%). Jewellery and objects of art: DMG Table 87 gives value ranges; enter the value.
AD2E.Treasure.Treasure: Gems, jewellery and objects of art
AD2E.Treasure.NoneYet: No gems or jewellery. Drag them here.

AD2E.Init.SettingHint: When one combatant rolls initiative from the combat tracker, ask for a situational modifier and reason (weapon speed, spell casting time, magical items). Rolling several at once never asks.
AD2E.Init.Title: Initiative: {name}

AD2E.AbilityRoll.Title: Roll ability scores
AD2E.AbilityRoll.Method2: Method II: 3d6 twice per ability, keep one
AD2E.AbilityRoll.Method4: Method IV: 3d6 twelve times, choose six, assign
AD2E.AbilityRoll.Method5: Method V: 4d6 drop lowest, six times, assign
AD2E.AbilityRoll.Method6: Method VI: each ability 8, add seven d6
AD2E.AbilityRoll.Hint2: Two 3d6 rolls per ability, in order (Strength first); pick one of each pair (Rolling Ability Scores (PHB)).
AD2E.AbilityRoll.Hint3: Six 3d6 rolls; assign each to one ability.
AD2E.AbilityRoll.Hint4: Twelve 3d6 rolls; assign six of them, one per ability (the six highest are preselected).
AD2E.AbilityRoll.Hint5: Six rolls of 4d6, the lowest die discarded; assign each to one ability.
AD2E.AbilityRoll.Hint6: Every ability starts at 8. Add each of the seven dice, whole, to one ability; no score above 18 (an 18 only by exact count).
AD2E.AbilityRoll.UsedTwice: Roll #{roll} is assigned to more than one ability.
AD2E.AbilityRoll.Unassigned: Assign a roll to every ability.
AD2E.AbilityRoll.OverMax: {ability} would be {score}; no score may exceed {max}.
AD2E.AbilityRoll.Exceptional: Roll exceptional Strength (d100): warrior with Strength 18
AD2E.AbilityRoll.ConfirmApply: Replace this character's rolled ability scores with these?
AD2E.AbilityRoll.DiceLeft: Add every die to an ability.

AD2E.Opaque.SettingHint: Give AD&D 2e sheets and windows a solid background. Foundry's windows are slightly transparent and rely on a blur that is turned off in low-performance mode, which lets text behind a window show through.

AD2E.Health.SettingHint: When characters die. Standard: at 0 hit points (Character Death, PHB). Hovering on Death's Door (DMG optional rule): unconscious at 0, losing 1 hit point each round until wounds are bound, dead at -10. Monsters always die at 0.
AD2E.Health.RuleDeathsDoor: Hovering on Death's Door: unconscious at 0, dead at -10 (DMG optional)
AD2E.Health.RuleStandardShort: Death rule: dead at 0 hit points
AD2E.Health.RuleDeathsDoorShort: Death rule: Hovering on Death's Door (dead at -10)

State.feeble: Weak and feeble until a day of rest

AD2E.Health.MassiveHint: 50 or more points from a single attack: saving throw vs. death or die (Character Death, PHB).
AD2E.Health.NowFeeble: Restored to 1 hit point only: weak and feeble until a day of rest; memorized spells are lost.
AD2E.Health.MassiveSaved: Massive damage: saving throw vs. death {roll} (needs {target}) — survives the shock.
AD2E.Health.MassiveFailed: Massive damage: saving throw vs. death {roll} (needs {target}) — dies of the shock.
AD2E.Health.NoHealingDead: Healing has no effect on {name}, who is dead (raise dead or resurrection is needed).
AD2E.Health.FeebleNoCure: Further cures do {name} no good until a day of rest.
AD2E.Health.Bound: {name}'s wounds are bound: no further loss of hit points, still unconscious.
AD2E.Health.RestHint: Natural healing (PHB): 1 hit point per day of rest; complete bed rest 3 per day, plus the Constitution bonus for each full week. Needs food, water and sleep.
AD2E.Health.RaiseHint: Raise dead or resurrection: resurrection survival roll (Table 3); success lowers Constitution by 1 permanently.
AD2E.Health.CannotRaise: {name}'s Constitution is too low to be raised.
AD2E.Health.ApplyHealing: Apply as healing to selected tokens
AD2E.Health.PunchNote: ({n} punching damage: 75% of it returns after the fight)
AD2E.Health.TempNote: ({n} of it temporary, returning one turn after the fight)
AD2E.Health.TempRecovered: {name} recovers {n} hit points of temporary damage ({before} → {after}).
AD2E.Health.PunchLasting: {n} of the punching damage is lasting.
AD2E.Health.RecoverHint: Attacking Without Killing (PHB): 75% of punching damage returns at the end of the fight and the temporary half of non-lethal weapon damage one turn after it. Done automatically when a combat encounter ends (non-lethal: after one turn of game time); this button does it now.
AD2E.Health.ApplyDamageRollTargets: Apply damage to the targets of the roll
AD2E.Health.ApplyDamageMyTargets: Apply damage to my targeted tokens
AD2E.Health.ApplyHealingMyTargets: Apply as healing to my targeted tokens
AD2E.Health.NotOwner: No permission to change {name}'s hit points; ask the GM to apply it.

NoTargets.roll: The roll had no targeted tokens.
NoTargets.mine: Target one or more tokens first (T key or right-click > Target).
NoTargets.selected: Select one or more tokens first.

AD2E.Surprise.Title: Surprise
AD2E.Surprise.Hint: 1d10: surprised on 1-3 (The Surprise Roll, PHB); a plus makes surprise less likely. Situations: DMG Table 57.

AD2E.Xp.Title: Award experience
AD2E.Xp.MenuHint: Divide a group experience award equally among the party (Experience Point Awards, DMG), with each character's prime requisite bonus. Also game.ad2e.awardExperience().
AD2E.Xp.Hint: Group awards are divided equally among the party (Experience Point Awards, DMG). Pick defeated monsters from the current combat and add other XP (story, treasure); each share gets the character's prime requisite bonus.

AD2E.TwoWeapons.Label: Two weapons
AD2E.TwoWeapons.MainWeapon: Main weapon in the other hand
AD2E.TwoWeapons.Shield: a shield cannot be used while fighting with two weapons
AD2E.TwoWeapons.TooLarge: the second weapon must be smaller and lighter than {main} (a dagger is always allowed)
AD2E.TwoWeapons.Summary: Two weapons: main {main}, second {off} (one extra attack per round)

AD2E.Unarmed.Title: Unarmed
AD2E.Unarmed.Meta: Punching, wrestling, overbearing (Attacking Without Killing, PHB)

Hint.punch: Damage and knockout chance by the modified roll (PHB Table 58).
Hint.wrestle: Needs both hands free. Move by the modified roll (PHB Table 58); armour gives the Table 57 penalty.
Hint.overbear: Several attackers: one roll at the weakest attacker's THAC0, +1 per extra attacker; size of the largest.

AD2E.Unarmed.ArmedDefender: An armed defender strikes first with +{bonus} to attack and damage.
AD2E.Unarmed.HoldRound: Maintain a hold: round (2+, no roll)
AD2E.Unarmed.Down: Defender already pulled down (attempt to pin)
AD2E.Unarmed.PulledDown: Hit: the defender is pulled down
AD2E.Unarmed.PunchDamage: {damage} punching damage ({lasting}% lasting, the rest temporary; split the total after the fight)
